survey.name: Version
survey.label:
**Version: 1.9 **
 05 Dec 2025 at 16:30 **Updates:** Added new WASH related organisations to the dropdown list.
- 03 Dec 2025 at 18:00 **Updates:** Added new WASH sector activity types (assessment, household water storage, household water distribution, and maintenance/rehabilitation of water systems). Added multiple new WASH-related organisations, including national and international actors.
- 25 Nov 2025 at 17:30 **Updates:** Added “Child Protection” sector, new related dropdown options, and additional national organizations.
- 24 Nov 2025 at 14:00 **Updates:** changed UK-Med to "UK EMT - United Kingdom Emergency Medical Team"
- 19 Nov 2025 at 12:00 **Updates:** added The Salvation Army to list of organizations; modified non-food items reource list; added Emergency Telecommunications to sector list.
- 14 Nov 2025 at 21:00 **Updates:** set to load the most recently submitted organization details by default; added nutrition sector; added type of location for the activity; added summary figures for population targeted and reached.

survey.name: Intro_instructions
survey.label:
Thank you for taking the time to register your organisation’s response to Hurricane Melissa in Jamaica.
Please note that each submission should represent one single activity.

Data is aggregated at the community level, therefore, if your activity covers multiple communities, you will need to enter disaggregated figures for each community. A looping section in the form will guide you through this process.

If you encounter any issues while completing the form, please contact 5W Support Team at [melissa-5w-support@undac.org](mailto:melissa-5w-support@undac.org) for assistance.

survey.name: start_date
survey.label: Start date
survey.constraint: (    (${activity_Status} = 'PLANNED' and . >= date('2025-10-28')) or    ((${activity_Status} = 'IN_PROGRESS' or ${activity_Status} = 'COMPLETED') and . >= date('2025-10-28') and . <= today()))
survey.constraint_message: For planned activities, the start date can be in the future. For ongoing or completed activities, it must be between 28 Oct 2025 and today.

survey.name: end_date
survey.label: End date
survey.constraint: (    (${activity_Status} = 'COMPLETED' and . >= ${start_date} and . <= today()) or    ((${activity_Status} = 'PLANNED' or ${activity_Status} = 'IN_PROGRESS') and . >= ${start_date}))
survey.constraint_message: End date must be after the start date. It can be in the future only if the activity is planned or in progress.
